title: Broadband soliton microcombs in the biological window enabled by a resonant coupler
abstract: Broadband soliton microcombs near 1 $\mu$m offer coherent, evenly spaced optical lines for measurements in the biological window. However, combining broad spectral coverage with closely spaced comb lines increases the pump-power requirement and makes thermally stable soliton access more difficult. Here, we demonstrate broadband silicon nitride (Si3N4) soliton microcombs enabled by a resonant coupler that enhances pump delivery to the nonlinear resonator. The device generates a spectrum spanning 930-1380 nm with an approximately 98-GHz comb-line spacing at on-chip pump powers of tens of milliwatts, while providing reliable thermally stable access to the single-soliton state. These results provide a route to compact, power-efficient microcomb sources that combine broad spectral coverage with closely spaced comb lines for spectroscopy and imaging in the biological window.

summaries.en: The paper reports broadband silicon nitride soliton microcombs spanning 930–1380 nm with ~98‑GHz line spacing, using a resonant coupler to boost pump delivery so that stable single-soliton operation is achieved at on-chip pump powers of tens of milliwatts for applications in the biological window.
summaries.zh: 论文展示了一种借助谐振耦合器增强泵浦输运的方案，在芯片内泵浦功率为数十毫瓦条件下实现了覆盖930–1380 nm、梳线间隔约98 GHz的宽带Si3N4孤子微梳，并可靠获得热稳定的单孤子态，为面向生物窗口的光谱与成像提供了紧凑且更省电的微梳光源路径。

title: Coherent ultraviolet frequency combs generated by resonant dispersive waves
abstract: Resonant dispersive wave (RDW) emission in gas-filled anti-resonant hollow-core fibers (AR-HCF) offers a wavelength-tunable route to ultraviolet (UV) and vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) frequency comb generation. RDW emission is expected to be coherent fundamentally, but various noise sources are expected to limit the coherence, including amplitude-to-phase fluctuations due to input pulse intensity noise and plasma formation. It is critical, therefore, to establish the limits of the coherence of UV RDW pulses to determine their applicability for precision spectroscopy. Here, we demonstrate the coherence of RDW emission at 260~nm generated with an amplified Yb-doped fiber system at a 2-MHz repetition rate with a self-heterodyne beat measurement between the RDW and the fourth harmonic of the source. We isolate the RDW contribution to the frequency noise by coherently subtracting the carrier-envelope offset noise contribution measured simultaneously with an f-2f interferometer. We observe a beatnote linewidth below 10~kHz over timescales longer than 100~ms, and we find a conservative upper bound of 1~rad on the integrated RMS phase deviations over a frequency range spanning 1 to 30~kHz. The dominant frequency noise contributions are consistent with environmental noise of the interferometers and AR-HCF coupling fluctuations. These results provide strong evidence that RDW emission is coherent under well-controlled experimental conditions, confirming its potential for UV and VUV frequency comb generation.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that resonant dispersive wave emission at 260 nm from gas-filled anti-resonant hollow-core fibers can generate a highly coherent ultraviolet frequency comb, evidenced by sub-10 kHz self-heterodyne beat linewidth and an integrated RMS phase-deviation upper bound of 1 rad (1–30 kHz) after subtracting carrier-envelope offset noise, with dominant noise traced to interferometer environmental effects and fiber coupling fluctuations.
summaries.zh: 论文证明，充入气体的反共振中空纤维中产生的260 nm共振色散波发射可用于产生高度相干的紫外频率梳：通过自外差拍频测得拍频线宽低于10 kHz，并在用f-2f干涉仪测得载波包络偏移噪声后进行相干扣除，给出了频率范围1–30 kHz内积分RMS相位偏差的保守上限为1 rad，且主要噪声来源与干涉仪环境噪声及纤维耦合波动一致，从而证实在良好实验条件下RDW发射具有相干性并具备生成UV/VUV频率梳的潜力。

title: Theory of Disorder-Induced Multimode Coupling in a Fabry-Pérot Cavity
abstract: Strong light--matter interactions have attracted significant interest in physical chemistry due to the potential for modifying molecular processes by hybridizing with cavity photons and forming polaritonic states. However, for a disordered molecular ensemble within an optical cavity capable of supporting multiple photon modes, theoretical understanding of multimode polaritons remains incomplete, particularly regarding whether and how distinct photon modes are mutually coupled through molecules. In this work, we generalize the collective mode expansion formalism to incorporate multiple photonic modes and show that spatial and orientational disorder in the light--matter coupling strength (originating from dipole orientation fluctuations and photonic field inhomogeneity) can mediate cross-mode coupling. This disorder-induced coupling allows for energy transfer to otherwise unexcited photon modes through a mechanism termed disorder-induced multimode activation (DIMA). Using an effective one-dimensional Fabry--Pérot cavity as a test system, we demonstrate that the cross-mode energy transfer through DIMA can be controlled by changing the molecular layer thickness and the optical properties of the mirrors. Furthermore, we show that DIMA is robust against weak energetic disorder. This mechanistic understanding lays the foundation for a systematic control of multimode photon coupling using disorder-induced effects.

summaries.en: The paper extends collective-mode theory to multi-mode Fabry-Pérot cavities and shows that spatial and orientational disorder in light–matter coupling can induce cross-mode photon coupling, enabling disorder-induced multimode activation (DIMA) where energy is transferred to otherwise unexcited modes in a controllable and robust (against weak energetic disorder) way by varying molecular layer thickness and mirror optical properties.
summaries.zh: 该论文将集体模展开理论推广到多模Fabry–Pérot腔中，并表明光—物质耦合的空间与取向无序会介导模间光子耦合，从而实现“由无序引发的多模激活”(DIMA)：使能量能够转移到原本未被激发的其他光子模，且可通过改变分子层厚度与镜面光学性质进行调控，并且对弱能量无序具有稳健性。

title: Phantom Zernike Wavefront Sensor: Phase Contrast with Engineered Focal Plane Reference Speckles
abstract: We introduce the Phantom Zernike Wavefront Sensor (phantom ZWFS), an engineered reference extension of phase-contrast wavefront sensing in which controlled pupil plane modulation generates off-axis coherent speckle structures that undergo localized focal plane phase shifts. These references may replace the central ZWFS reference when the on-axis PSF core is required for another optical function, such as photonic science coupling, or may augment a conventional central ZWFS response to provide additional wavefront information. Using a monochromatic scalar model, we derive the resulting carrier structure and show how the engineered references can be recovered through spatial demodulation and incorporated into calibrated reconstruction. A simple four-reference realization demonstrates that the reference geometry redistributes photon sensitivity across spatial frequency magnitude and orientation, producing mode dependent changes in linearity and cross-talk rather than a uniform improvement over a classical ZWFS. We then consider differential piston on a seven segment aperture as an application specific example. A hybrid sensor retaining the central ZWFS phase region and adding six engineered references that match the segment geometry gives similar precision near the phased state but substantially improved performance at larger piston excursions. Under the adopted photon-noise-limited benchmark, the hybrid reduces the nonlinear reconstruction error and provides better conditioned optical encoding of the piston state than an idealized vector ZWFS, allowing more precise piston estimation from the same detected photon flux at larger piston excursions.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics (astro-ph.IM)

summaries.en: The paper proposes the Phantom Zernike Wavefront Sensor, which creates engineered off-axis speckle references via pupil-plane modulation to enable phase-contrast wavefront sensing without relying solely on the central Zernike reference, and shows through modeling and a piston-on-segments example that an augmented hybrid design can improve performance for larger phase excursions by redistributing photon sensitivity and reducing nonlinear reconstruction error.
summaries.zh: 论文提出幻影Zernike波前传感器，通过在瞳面调制中生成受控的离轴相干散斑参考来实现相位对比波前探测，从而不必完全依赖中心Zernike参考；并通过建模与分段孔径上的活塞差动示例表明，加入工程化参考的混合方案可通过重新分配光子敏感度、降低非线性重建误差在更大的相位偏移范围内显著提升性能。

title: Topologically steerable ultra-flat electro-optic combs via non-Hermitian frequency lattices
abstract: Electro-optic (EO) frequency combs convert microwave signals to the optical domain with deterministic repetition rates, enabling applications in optical telecommunications, microwave photonics, and LiDAR. However, generating flat EO combs has remained a long-standing challenge due to exponential decay of the spectral envelope inherent to bidirectional frequency coupling within conventional schemes. Here we reveal the inherent correspondence between flat-comb generation and the topological energy bands of non-Hermitian nonreciprocal frequency lattices, and experimentally realize ultra-flat combs with topologically controlled spectral flow. We derive the exact analytical condition for flat-comb generation, and find that it maps precisely onto the complex energy band, thereby establishing a direct connection between comb-envelope engineering and non-Hermitian topology. Experimentally, we observe an ultra-flat comb whose frequency evolution direction is governed by the topological winding and remains robust against detuning and phase fluctuations. This scheme can be further extended to long-range coupling and multi-lattice architectures, underscoring its versatility for flat dual- and multi-comb generation. Our work establishes a topologically steerable approach for achieving ultra-flat EO combs, paving the way for chip-scale spectral engineering via non-Hermitian topology.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and experimentally demonstrates ultra-flat electro-optic frequency combs by mapping the exact analytical condition for flat-comb generation to topological energy bands of non-Hermitian nonreciprocal frequency lattices, yielding topologically steerable spectral flow that is robust to detuning and phase noise and extendable to long-range and multi-lattice architectures.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过把获得超平坦电光频率梳的精确解析条件严格对应到非厄米、非互易频率晶格的拓扑能带，提出并实验实现了超平坦电光频率梳，从而实现由拓扑绕行决定且对失谐和相位波动具有鲁棒性的可控谱演化，并可进一步扩展到长程耦合与多晶格架构。

title: Silent breakdown of the perturbative polarization expansion in the terahertz regime
abstract: Nonlinear optics expands the polarization in powers of the drive and retains only the lowest-order terms. This truncation is safe at optical frequencies, where the convergence field lies far above the damage threshold. In the terahertz regime, phonon polaritons enhance the nonlinear susceptibilities by orders of magnitude, lowering the convergence field into the sub-damage range and opening a window in which the expansion fails while the crystal remains recoverable. We term this window silent breakdown. At resonance, the nearest singularities of the driven lattice mode are a complex-conjugate pair of branch points below the multistability threshold, so the response remains smooth and single-valued even though the $\chi^{\left( n \right)}$ description fails. The convergence field scales as $Q^{-3/2}$, so sharpening a resonance enhances the nonlinearity but narrows the range over which the expansion applies. It follows from the mode shift $S$ alone, $E_{\mathrm{conv}}=E_{\mathrm{ref}}(3\sqrt{3}QS)^{-1/2}$, giving 2$\sim$9 MV/cm for $\mathrm{LiNbO}_{3}$. Since resonant enhancement is central to terahertz nonlinear optics, this boundary defines the field range over which susceptibility-based descriptions are quantitatively reliable.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in the terahertz regime phonon-polariton-enhanced nonlinearities can make the perturbative polarization (susceptibility) expansion break down at fields below damage, producing a “silent breakdown” window where the macroscopic response stays smooth at resonance despite the failure of χ^(n) descriptions, with a convergence-field scaling E_conv ∝ (QS)^(-1/2) that yields about 2–9 MV/cm for LiNbO3.
summaries.zh: 论文指出，在太赫兹频段由于声子极化激元显著增强非线性，扰动极化（电磁学易用的χ^(n)）展开可能在低于损伤阈值的场强下失效，形成“静默崩塌”窗口；即便在共振处由于最近的奇点为位于多稳态阈值以下的复共轭分支点，响应仍保持平滑且单值，但χ^(n)描述失效，且收敛场随E_conv ∝ (QS)^(-1/2)缩放，对LiNbO3给出约2–9 MV/cm的可靠场强范围。

title: Matrix-free numerical continuation of the Ikeda map in passive Kerr resonators
abstract: We introduce a matrix-free numerical continuation framework for the Ikeda map of coherently driven passive Kerr resonators. The framework traces solution branches and evaluates their linear stability without explicitly assembling the full Jacobian matrices, using a unified formulation for states that recur after one or multiple round trips. We resolve stable and unstable branches of modulation-instability patterns and temporal cavity solitons, and uncover period-doubled homogeneous states and associated multi-round-trip dynamics that are absent from the standard Lugiato-Lefever equation (LLE). For period-1 states, the Ikeda map and the LLE show close agreement in the high-finesse regime, while their branch-existence intervals increasingly deviate as the finesse decreases. These results demonstrate that direct continuation of the unaveraged round-trip map can capture nonlinear states and multi-round-trip dynamics beyond the mean-field description, providing a systematic framework for bifurcation and stability analysis of Kerr resonators without relying on the averaged LLE.

summaries.en: The paper presents a matrix-free numerical continuation method for the Ikeda map of coherently driven passive Kerr resonators that tracks solution branches and their linear stability without forming Jacobians, revealing modulation-instability, temporal cavity solitons, and additional period-doubled multi-round-trip states beyond mean-field Lugiato–Lefever predictions and showing agreement with the LLE only at high finesse.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种用于相干驱动的无源Kerr谐振器Ikeda映射的矩阵自由数值延拓方法，能够在不显式构造雅可比矩阵的情况下追踪解分支并评估其线性稳定性，揭示了调制不稳定、时间腔体孤子以及超越均场Lugiato–Lefever预测的周期加倍多往返状态，并表明仅在高品质因数（高精细度）条件下其与LLE表现出较好一致性。

title: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
abstract: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. Based on these findings, we propose a SERS-active system that provides strong signal enhancement (up to four orders of magnitude for a single globular object) while maintaining spectral fidelity, where PMSs act both as model analytes and as integral components of a metal-dielectric resonator.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a bottom-up SERS method where metal is deposited on the surface of the object to be analyzed, uses Mie-theory and correlative SERS-AFM-SEM modeling to determine conditions for sensitive detection of polystyrene microspheres, and demonstrates a resonator design that yields up to four orders of magnitude signal enhancement for single globular objects while preserving spectral fidelity.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种自下而上的SERS策略，即在待检测对象表面沉积金属来实现表面增强拉曼散射，并结合米氏理论与SERS-AFM-SEM的关联表征来建模以获得对聚苯乙烯微球（球状/类囊泡对象）的灵敏检测条件，最终提出一种金属-介电谐振器系统，在保持光谱保真度的同时可使单个球状对象的信号增强最高达四个数量级。

title: Spectral-control-assisted Kerr-lens mode-locking in a Tm:Y2O3 ceramic laser
abstract: We report a soft-aperture Kerr-lens mode-locked Tm:Y2O3 ceramic laser stabilized by suppressing wavelength competition under high population-inversion conditions. The laser delivers an average output power of 0.5 W with a pulse duration of 112 fs at a repetition rate of 90 MHz and a central wavelength of 2.08 um. Further optimization for shorter pulses yields a pulse duration of 107 fs, through with a reduced output power of 0.22 W. These results demonstrate that spectral-control is an effective approach for achieving stable mode-locking in such laser with strong spectral competition.

summaries.zh: 论文报道了一种通过光谱控制抑制高种群反转条件下波长竞争的软孔径克尔透镜锁模Tm:Y2O3陶瓷激光，实现稳定锁模：在90 MHz下输出中心波长2.

title: UV Fluorescence Sensing of Medical-Chemical-and- Biological Analytes by an AlGaN/Si-on-Sapphire Optoelectronic Chip
abstract: This paper proposes and analyzes a compact fluorescence-photometer lab-on-a-chip that is simpler than a fluorescence spectrometer, and that does not require spectrum reconstruction by a computer. An on-chip AlGaN VCSEL lasing at 280 nm, or at 310 nm, pumps an on-chip sample in the form of liquid or solid or tissue, thereby exciting signature fluorescence in the 300 to 540 nm wavelength range. This emission signal is detected and read out by an on-chip UV-enhanced Silicon photodiode. The 2 cm x 5 cm chip consists of C-plane (0001) Sapphire, and no lenses, prisms, or mirrors are utilized in the photometer. The chip is opto-electronic and features co-packaged electronics using tiny electronic chiplets that are bonded to the sapphire. These consist of an LD driver and transimpedance amplifier for the UV photonics, together with ASICs, ADC, microcontroller, micro-battery and RF-wireless or Ethernet chiplets. The mission of this self-contained cost-effective chip is sensing targeted medical-chemical-biological (MCB) agents in a local or network setting. Eight significant MCB applications are detailed here.

summaries.en: The paper presents a compact AlGaN/Si-on-sapphire optoelectronic lab-on-a-chip fluorescence photometer that uses on-chip 280 or 310 nm VCSEL excitation and a UV-enhanced silicon photodiode to detect 300–540 nm signals without spectral reconstruction, featuring lensless optics and co-packaged electronics for low-cost local or network sensing of eight medical-chemical-biological applications.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种紧凑型AlGaN/Si-on-sapphire光电集成芯片荧光光度计，利用片上280或310 nm的VCSEL对300–540 nm特征荧光进行激发并由紫外增强硅光电二极管读取信号，从而无需计算机进行光谱重建，且采用无透镜光学并与集成电子器件共封装，以低成本实现本地或网络环境中面向八种医学-化学-生物（MCB）应用的检测。

title: Aubry-André transition in photonic time quasicrystals
abstract: In one dimension, Anderson localization by a disordered potential sets in at any strength, whereas localization by a quasiperiodic potential in the Aubry-André model occurs through a transition at a critical strength. Disordered photonic time crystals exhibit a temporal counterpart of this Anderson localization, in which light, instead of decaying in space, stops propagating and grows in time. Whether a counterpart of the Aubry-André transition exists in photonic time quasicrystals remains an open question. Here we show that it does, and that the transition occurs at mobility edges in momentum rather than in energy. These edges arise even under impulsive modulation, where the field obeys the self-dual almost-Mathieu equation exactly, and for general analytic modulations Avila's global theory reveals the condition under which they form. The Aubry-André transition thus extends from spatial lattices to the time domain, where it sorts light by wave number into components that propagate and components that stop and grow.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn); Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci); Mathematical Physics (math-ph)

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that photonic time quasicrystals exhibit an Aubry-André-type transition in which light shifts from propagating to time-localizing, with the critical behavior occurring at mobility edges in momentum rather than energy and being explained via the self-dual almost-Mathieu equation under impulsive modulation and Avila’s global theory for general analytic modulations.
summaries.zh: 本文表明光子时间准晶体存在类Aubry-André的跃迁：光从传播转变为时间局域并随时间增长，其临界行为表现为动量空间的可迁移边界而非能量，并通过脉冲调制下严格满足的自对偶几乎Mathieu方程以及一般解析调制下Avila的全局理论来解释，从而把光按波数分成传播分量与停止并增长分量。

title: Chiroptical Nonlinearity Found in Covalent Organic Frameworks
abstract: Chiroptical nonlinearity is vital for modern optics and photonics. However, it remains a central challenge to obtain a material simultaneously with large second-order nonlinearity and strong nonlinear optical chirality. Here we uncover the strong chiroptical nonlinearity in COF-330-a, owing to the formation of unique chiral, polar structure with large p-electron conjugation via structural transformation. A large effective second-order nonlinear susceptibility of ~ 101 pm/V and a strong nonlinear chiroptical response (SHG-CD: -1.60 to +1.66) have been demonstrated in individual COF-330-a microcrystals, transcending the performance trade-off limitation in conventional chiroptical materials. These findings open a new avenue for designing nonlinear chiroptical crystals which harness the duality of polarity and chirality and chemical versatility of COFs.

title: Statistical Optical Replication and Mixing of Spatial Information across Wavelengths
abstract: Accessing and combining the spatial information carried by light at different wavelengths is important for linking structured-light encoding with spectrally distinct detection channels. Here, we introduce a correlation-enabled linear-optical framework for cross-wavelength imaging, bidirectional replication, and spatial information mixing. Shared random holographic modulation establishes correlations between nondegenerate optical fields, allowing spatial information to be retrieved from joint intensity fluctuations. In the demonstrated replicator, a spatial pattern encoded at one wavelength is read out in the detection coordinates of another through intensity correlations. Selecting diffraction-order pairs produces correlation kernels containing either the product or the conjugate product of two input field envelopes. These operations reproduce the spatial algebra underlying sum- and difference-frequency generation, while the optical fields retain their original carrier frequencies. The theory accounts for wavelength-dependent propagation and coordinate scaling, linking the input structures to observable correlation patterns. Together, these results establish a common framework for cross-wavelength spatial information processing through engineered optical correlations and joint detection.

summaries.en: The paper presents a correlation-enabled linear-optical method that uses shared random holographic modulation to create cross-wavelength correlations, enabling bidirectional replication and mixing of spatial information between nondegenerate fields via joint intensity fluctuations and diffraction-order-selected correlation kernels.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于关联增强的线性光学方案，通过共享随机全息调制在非简并光场之间建立跨波长相关性，使得借助联合强度涨落实现空间信息的双向复制与混合，并通过选择不同衍射级次得到对应的相关核来实现类似和频/差频的空间代数。

title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Notably, in the extreme quantum limit at cryogenic temperatures, the magnetoresistance undergoes a dramatic reversal from negative to positive. This reversal points to a potential field-induced phase transition into a collective electronic state driven by enhanced electron-electron interactions. Our findings provide valuable insights into the unconventional chiral transport and emergent correlated quantum states under extreme magnetic fields.
subjects: Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) ; Applied Physics (physics.app-ph); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that doped Weyl-semiconductor tellurium hosts a highly tunable chiral-anomaly–induced negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that strengthens near the Weyl point, survives to room temperature, crosses to positive linear magnetoconductance beyond the quantum limit, and even reverses sign in the extreme quantum limit—suggesting a magnetic-field–driven transition to a correlated collective electronic state.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，掺杂的韦尔半导体碲可实现高度可调的手性异常负纵向磁阻：将费米能级推向韦尔点时负磁阻显著增强，并能稳定至室温；超过量子极限后出现正的线性磁导行为，而在极端量子极限且低温下磁阻发生由负转正的剧烈反转，提示在增强的电子-电子相互作用驱动下可能发生由磁场诱导的相变并形成关联的集体电子态。

Eight significant MCB applications are detailed here.

summaries.en: The paper presents a compact opto-electronic lab-on-a-chip photometer using an on-chip AlGaN VCSEL (280/310 nm) and a UV-enhanced silicon photodiode to detect fluorescence from 300–540 nm without spectral reconstruction, featuring a lensless AlGaN/Si-on-sapphire (2×5 cm) design with co-packaged electronics for cost-effective local or network sensing of medical-chemical-biological analytes and detailing eight applications.
summaries.zh: 本文提出并分析了一种紧凑型光致荧光检测芯片（lab-on-a-chip）光谱仪替代方案：通过芯片内AlGaN VCSEL（280/310 nm）激发样品产生300–540 nm特征荧光，并由片上UV增强硅光电二极管直接读出，无需计算机进行光谱重建；该2×5 cm基于蓝宝石（0001）且不使用透镜/棱镜/镜子的透镜自由（lensless）AlGaN/Si-on-sapphire光电器件集成了与蓝宝石共封装的小型电子芯片（含LD驱动与UV光学跨阻放大器、ASIC/ADC/微控制器/微电池及RF无线或以太网芯片），面向本地或网络场景以低成本检测医学-化学-生物（MCB）目标分析物，并给出了八个重要应用。

title: TLS loss in superconducting resonators on epitaxial hBN thin films
abstract: The integration of low-loss dielectrics into superconducting circuits is of importance to the functionality of quantum computers and sensors. In this work, we fabricate and measure niobium resonators atop few-layer, epitaxial hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) grown by Molecular Beam Epitaxy on a sapphire substrate and compare against a control counterpart without hBN. We conduct radiofrequency measurements which probe the responses to power, temperature, and temporal fluctuations of two-level systems. The resonators integrating hBN maintain low dielectric loss with a low-power internal loss tangent on the order of $10^{-6}$, and demonstrate hBN can be added to the conventional superconducting qubit stack with minimal degradation of the quality factor. This research represents a first step towards a materials-driven strategy to eliminate phonon-mediated correlated errors in solid-state quantum systems, which leverages the thermal properties of 2D materials to prevent athermal phonons excited in the device substrate from transmitting across the superconductor-substrate interface. The same technique applied to quantum sensors would maximize phonon collection by blocking phonons from entering passive metal films.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Experiment (hep-ex)

summaries.en: The authors fabricate niobium superconducting resonators with epitaxial few-layer hBN on sapphire and find that integrating hBN preserves low dielectric loss (loss tangent ~10⁻⁶) and quality factor, supporting a materials-driven approach to suppress phonon-mediated two-level-system errors and improve solid-state quantum devices.
summaries.zh: 作者在蓝宝石上生长外延少层hBN并制备Nb超导谐振器，结果表明引入hBN可保持低介电损耗（损耗角正切约10⁻⁶）和较小的品质因子退化，从而支持一种材料驱动的策略以抑制与声子介导的两能级系统相关误差，并提升固态量子器件性能。

title: Correlated Pair Creation with Positive- and Negative-Frequency Oscillators in a Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulator
abstract: Spin-dependent forces enable independent control over the effective frequencies of bosonic motional modes and their coupling strengths to spins in trapped-ion spin-boson quantum simulators. We show that the relative signs of these effective frequencies provide an important programmable resource for engineering distinct multimode dynamics. Focusing on a two-mode quantum Rabi model, changing the frequencies of the two modes from the same sign to opposite signs reorganizes the resonance structure of the spin-mediated bosonic interaction, converting the dominant resonant process from excitation exchange to correlated pair creation. In the dispersive regime, the resulting effective interaction realizes a two-mode parametric amplifier with stable oscillatory, critical, and exponentially amplifying regimes separated by a spin-dependent instability threshold. Across these regimes, the dynamics generate collective-quadrature squeezing and bipartite motional entanglement. Preparing the spin in a coherent superposition further allows different spin components to experience distinct stability regimes, generating tripartite spin-boson entanglement, while spin postselection can coherently combine the conditional bosonic branches to generate non-Gaussian entangled bosonic states. Finally, we outline an implementation using parameters within reach of current trapped-ion platforms.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: Using trapped-ion spin-boson quantum simulation, the authors show that switching the effective signs of two bosonic mode frequencies reorganizes the two-mode quantum Rabi resonance structure from excitation exchange to correlated pair creation, yielding a two-mode parametric-amplifier interaction with controllable stability regimes, quadrature squeezing, motional entanglement, and—via superposition and spin postselection—tripartite and non-Gaussian entangled bosonic states within current experimental capabilities.
summaries.zh: 该论文在俘获离子自旋-玻色量子模拟中表明，通过改变两个玻色模的有效频率符号，可将双模量子Rabi的共振结构从激发交换重组为相关成对产生，从而实现一个两模参量放大器式的有效相互作用并呈现由自旋介导不稳定阈值分隔的稳定振荡、临界与指数放大三种稳定性区间，进而产生集体四分量挤压与双模振动（motional）纠缠；进一步地，利用自旋相干叠加与自旋后选可生成三体自旋-玻色纠缠及非高斯纠缠玻色态，并给出了在现有平台参数可及范围内的实现方案。

title: Optimal linear-optical interferometers for unitary t-designs in a multi-photon Fock space
abstract: We investigate the construction of unitary $t$-designs in a multi-photon Fock space on programmable linear-optical interferometers. Using the frame potential as the optimization objective, we identify architectures that realize approximate unitary 1- and 2-designs with considerably fewer controllable parameters than required for universal linear optics. For example, we find numerical evidence suggesting that for unitary 1-designs, the required number of programmable parameters scales empirically as $2d$ with the number of modes $d$, instead of $O(d^2)$. We benchmark the resulting ensembles using single-photon transition probabilities and average channel fidelities. Furthermore, as a practical result, we develop a photon-number estimation protocol for multi-photon Fock states that leverages these optimized 1- and 2-designs. Our findings demonstrate that shallow interferometers can accurately reproduce Haar-averaged first moments, while second-moment-sensitive observables provide a considerably stricter test for approximate unitary 2-designs.

summaries.en: The paper presents frame-potential-based architectures for building approximate unitary t-designs in multi-photon Fock space with programmable linear-optical interferometers, showing that unitary 1- and 2-designs can be achieved with far fewer parameters than universal linear optics (e.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出基于保真势（frame potential）的架构，用可编程线性光学干涉仪在多光子Fock空间中构建近似的幺正t-设计，并表明实现单位幺正1-和2-设计所需参数比通用线性光学少得多（例如1-设计所需参数的经验标度接近2d而非O(d^2)），随后通过单光子跃迁概率与平均信道保真度对这些设计进行基准测试，并利用优化后的1-和2-设计实现多光子Fock态的光子数估计方案。

title: Analog quantum simulation of Shastry-Sutherland Ising materials
abstract: Frustrated magnets host rich emergent behavior because competing interactions generate dense manifolds of low-energy states. The Ising Shastry-Sutherland model is a paradigmatic setting, motivated experimentally by Ising-like rare-earth tetraborides such as TmB$_4$ and ErB$_4$, whose field-induced magnetization plateaus have motivated extensive microscopic modeling. Yet how tunable quantum fluctuations reorganize this material-motivated phase diagram remains largely unexplored. Here, we realize a transverse- and longitudinal-field Ising model on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice using a programmable Rydberg-atom array. We map its quantum phase diagram using density matrix renormalization group calculations and probe corresponding signatures experimentally in arrays containing more than 110 atoms. Beyond the established classical phases, the calculations identify two regimes absent in the classical limit and stabilized at finite transverse field: a $2/5$ filling plateau whose finite stability region emerges from a classically degenerate phase boundary and a symmetry-preserving quantum-dimer regime replacing classically selected collinear order. Experiments on finite open arrays reveal signatures consistent with these regimes across three boundary-pinning conditions, with the resulting response maps agreeing qualitatively with the calculated phase diagram. Our results establish programmable Rydberg-atom arrays as tools for exploring frustrated, material-motivated Hamiltonians and motivate searches for new, quantum-driven magnetization plateaus and quantum-dimer behavior in ErB$_4$ under a transverse field or in strain-tuned TmB$_4$.

summaries.en: The paper reports an analog Rydberg-atom quantum simulation of the transverse- and longitudinal-field Shastry–Sutherland Ising model, mapping its quantum phase diagram via DMRG and observing experimentally in 110+ atom arrays two finite-transverse-field regimes—a novel 2/5 filling plateau and a symmetry-preserving quantum-dimer phase—whose signatures in open arrays agree qualitatively with calculations and suggest routes to explore related behavior in materials like ErB4 and TmB4.
summaries.zh: 该论文使用可编程的里德堡原子阵列实现了横向与纵向场下的 Shastry–Sutherland 伊辛模型模拟，通过 DMRG 绘制其量子相图，并在含 110+ 个原子的实验阵列中观测到两种在经典极限之外、由有限横场稳定的新区域：2/5 填充平台以及保持对称性的量子二聚子相，其在开放阵列中的边界钉扎响应与计算结果在定性上高度一致，并为在 ErB4 与 TmB4 等材料中探索相关新的磁化平台与量子二聚子行为提供了思路。

title: Trainable Quantum-Native Language Models: Dissipative Memory, Capacity Limits, and Hardware Validation
abstract: We study byte-level autoregressive language models whose hidden state is a small quantum register, whose transitions are learned token-conditioned quantum channels, and whose next-byte probabilities come directly from Born-rule measurements without a learned classical vocabulary projection or softmax. In the fixed-width recurrent setting, unitary dynamics cannot contract or reset stored distinctions; experimentally, unitary recurrence loses to its retrained one-token control in every tested variant. Introducing learned dissipation, then token-conditioned dissipative gating, yields useful memory beyond one token. The gated model improves test negative log-likelihood by 0.20 +/- 0.03 nats/byte over retrained parameter-matched one-token controls at context length 12, and by 0.29-0.33 at longer contexts, but never beats retrained two-token controls. A key-value recall benchmark shows a width-dependent threshold: one stored pair meets the pre-registered accuracy bar at 4-5 memory qubits, two pairs at 6-7, and three pairs remain unsolved. This is consistent with, but does not establish, a capacity explanation for the short effective memory horizon. As a secondary result, one-qubit models reach lower stationary memory entropy than a heuristically optimized classical predictive frontier at matched error in 9/9 seeds. On IBM Heron hardware, computational-basis memory-register distributions show signal against a uniform null in 12/12 circuits across prefixes of up to 12 tokens, next-bit probabilities pass pre-registered accuracy bars at four-token prefixes, and bytes are generated autoregressively by sampling physically measured bit probabilities. The tested models are classically simulable and substantially worse than classical n-gram baselines. We claim no computational quantum advantage.

summaries.en: The paper presents trainable byte-level autoregressive language models with quantum-register hidden states and token-conditioned quantum channels using Born-rule measurements, finding that unitary recurrence has only one-token effective memory but learned dissipative gating extends useful memory (up to 12 tokens improving NLL vs one-token controls) though never surpasses two-token controls, with a width-dependent key-value recall threshold and hardware tests on IBM Heron showing statistically detectable quantum memory effects without demonstrating any computational quantum advantage.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种以量子寄存器作为隐藏状态、由令牌条件化的量子信道进行转移并直接利用Born规则测量产生下一字节概率的可训练字节级自回归语言模型，结果表明纯幺正递推的有效记忆仅约一令牌而引入学习到的耗散门控可将有用记忆延长到12令牌左右（相较一令牌控制在NLL上有提升），但始终无法超过两令牌控制；在关键值回忆基准中记忆宽度存在阈值且硬件在IBM Heron上的实验显示量子记忆分布的可检测信号与物理测量概率生成的自回归字节生成表现，但并未证明任何计算意义上的量子优势。

title: All-optical deconvolution via quantum cross-correlation spectroscopy with bright twin beams
abstract: The resolution of spectroscopic measurements is fundamentally limited by the convolution between a system's intrinsic response and the instrument response function, creating an ill-posed inverse problem. While entangled photons can theoretically bypass these limits, low photon flux has hindered their experimental realization. Here, we propose quantum cross-correlation spectroscopy (QCCS), utilizing macroscopic twin beams (signal and idler beams) to physically circumvent this convolution limit in coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering. Employing the signal beam as a broadband probe, QCCS achieves all-optical deconvolution through a correlation-enhanced sum-frequency generation channel between the convoluted anti-Stokes and idler beams. By subtracting the uncorrelated background using a 500-femtosecond temporal window, we successfully retrieve narrow Raman bands (8 cm^{-1} and 15 cm^{-1}) completely obscured by a 75 cm^{-1} probe bandwidth without numerical deconvolution or prior knowledge. Our results establish macroscopic quantum correlations as a robust resource for high-fidelity spectroscopy, paving the way for ultrashort-pulse-free operando studies under natural, incoherent excitation conditions.

summaries.en: The paper proposes quantum cross-correlation spectroscopy using bright twin beams to achieve all-optical deconvolution in coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering by exploiting quantum correlations to remove the convolution-limited instrument response, retrieving Raman bands hidden within a broad probe bandwidth without numerical deconvolution or prior knowledge.
summaries.zh: 本文提出利用亮态孪生光束的量子交叉相关光谱（QCCS）在相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射中实现全光学去卷积：通过量子相关增强的通道绕过由固有响应与仪器响应卷积导致的分辨率限制，并在无需数值去卷积或先验知识的情况下，在宽探测带宽下成功恢复先前被完全掩盖的窄拉曼谱峰。

title: Continuous-wave AC magnetometry up to hundreds of megahertz using nitrogen-vacancy centers under a strong transverse magnetic field
abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond are promising quantum sensors for AC magnetic fields. However, conventional dynamical-decoupling-based magnetometry becomes technically demanding at high frequencies because of the requirement for increasingly short and high-power microwave pulses. This paper describes an AC magnetometry technique based on continuous-wave optically detected magnetic resonance (CW-ODMR) measurements, which enables the detection of signals in the hundred-MHz range. By applying a strong static magnetic field transverse to the NV axis, the energy separation between the relevant electron-spin states was tuned and resonantly coupled with the target radiofrequency (RF) magnetic field, thereby forming RF-dressed states. Unlike pulsed dynamical-decoupling schemes, this approach does not require high-power microwave pulse sequences. The key feature of our method is that the detectable frequency can be tuned by controlling the bias magnetic field strength. Using this methodology, we have experimentally achieved the frequency-tunable detection of AC magnetic fields from 14.4-632 MHz. The sensitivity was 0.558 uT/Hz^(0.5) at 14.4 MHz and 24.4 uT/Hz^(0.5) at 632 MHz. We characterized the field-dependent ODMR contrast and linewidth, and found that their degradation at large transverse fields is a important factor limiting the high-frequency sensitivity. These results establish a simple CW-ODMR approach for widely tunable RF magnetic-field sensing without high-power pulsed spin control.

summaries.en: The paper presents a continuous-wave optically detected magnetic resonance (CW-ODMR) AC magnetometry method using nitrogen-vacancy centers under a strong transverse magnetic field to resonantly couple RF fields via RF-dressed states, enabling frequency-tunable detection from 14.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于金刚石中氮空位（NV）色心、在强横向磁场下工作的连续波光学检测磁共振（CW-ODMR）交流磁场测量方法，通过RF“致穿态”与目标射频场共振耦合来实现频率可调检测，并避免高功率脉冲微波控制，实验实现14.

title: Wideband microwave resonator for NV center vector magnetometry
abstract: The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) color center in diamond has found applications in magnetometry across various geometrical scales. In particular, vector magnetometry using hand-held devices with low power consumption is of interest for mobile and geological applications. However, such a device requires efficient driving of the four different orientations of the NV center, thus placing demands on a broadband microwave resonator that provides a uniform and highly insensitive microwave magnetic field at the resonance frequencies of the NV centers. Here, we propose a unique planar resonator design that enables efficient driving of all four orientations of NV color centers over a 100 MHz range with only 0.5 W of microwave input power and 250 mW of laser power, allowing vector magnetic field measurements. Using the planar resonator to drive NV centers in diamond, a compact vector magnetometer was fabricated and experimentally studied. The sensitivity of the device is about \[{1.2\text{ nT}}/{\sqrt{\text{Hz}}}\;\]. While this is not a record sensitivity for diamond-based magnetometers, this device occupies its own niche as a compact hand-held magnetometer.

summaries.en: The paper presents a compact planar broadband microwave resonator that enables efficient, orientation-selective driving of all four NV center orientations over a 100 MHz range with low microwave and laser power, enabling handheld vector magnetometry with an achieved sensitivity of about 1.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种紧凑的平面宽带微波谐振器，可在100 MHz范围内以仅0.

title: Modelling Josephson Junctions with Boundary Conditions: Towards High-Fidelity Models for Superconducting Qubits
abstract: Josephson junctions are the central nonlinear element of superconducting qubits, yet their standard description is reached through a chain of approximations. We propose a purely quantum-mechanical model of the junction, formulated directly in Hilbert space: a charged particle moves on a one-dimensional loop, and the junction is a point at which the wave function obeys self-adjoint boundary conditions, labelled by a coupling strength $\lambda$, which controls the transparency of the junction, and a phase jump $\delta$, which plays the role of the superconducting phase difference. For a loop with a single junction we solve the spectral problem and show that the ground-state momentum expectation, identified with the supercurrent, factorises exactly as $\langle\hat{p}_0\rangle = I_c(\delta,\lambda)\sin\delta$. For opaque junctions $I_c$ becomes independent of $\delta$ and the first Josephson relation $I=I_c\sin\delta$ is recovered; for strongly attractive coupling, where the ground state is bound to the junction, the $\sin\delta$ law is also recovered, but with an exponentially suppressed amplitude. For more transparent junctions, however, the model \emph{predicts} deviations from the pure $\sin\delta$ law: $I_c$ acquires a dependence on $\delta$ already at order $\lambda^{-2}$, compatible with the higher Josephson harmonics recently found necessary to describe superconducting qubit spectra, and a fully transparent contact yields a current linear in $\delta$. When the phase varies in time, a gauge transformation shows that the voltage drop across the junction is proportional to $\dot\delta$, so that the second Josephson relation emerges without being imposed. The boundary-condition approach thus reproduces both Josephson relations from first principles and predicts corrections to them, offering a route towards higher-fidelity models of superconducting qubits.

summaries.en: The paper presents a fully quantum Hilbert-space model of a Josephson junction using self-adjoint boundary conditions on a loop wavefunction, deriving the supercurrent and both Josephson relations from first principles while predicting δ-dependent deviations (including higher harmonics) for more transparent junctions that could improve superconducting qubit modeling fidelity.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种在希尔伯特空间中用自伴边界条件描述约瑟夫森结的纯量子模型：通过在一维闭合回路的波函数处施加由耦合强度 λ 与相位跃迁 δ 控制透明度与相位差的边界条件，解出能谱并从一阶原则推得超电流与两条约瑟夫森关系，同时预测在更透明结中 I_c 会在 λ^{-2} 阶出现对 δ 的依赖、从而产生与超导量子比特能谱相关的高阶谐波偏离，并为提高量子比特高保真建模提供途径。

title: Encoding Matters: A Qubit-Efficient Reformulation for Quantum Resilient Routing
abstract: Qubits are powerful computational resources because each additional qubit doubles the size of the accessible state space. This expressive power comes at a cost: adding qubits also increases circuit size, constraint overhead, and exposure to hardware noise. These limitations are especially critical for near-term quantum computers, making the number of qubits required to formulate a problem a central practical concern. In this work, we present a method for efficiently mapping logistics and routing problems onto qubits through structure-aware encoding reduction. We demonstrate the method on a benchmark problem of latency-resilient routing under dual-link failures. For this benchmark, the reduced formulation substantially lowers both the qubit count and the compiled circuit complexity while preserving the original optimization task. By running the reduced model on the same trapped-ion quantum computer as the benchmark, we obtain a 100X improvement in the success probability. This finding shows how careful problem formulation can make current quantum hardware substantially more effective for practical optimization.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn); Computational Physics (physics.comp-ph)

summaries.en: The paper introduces a structure-aware qubit-efficient encoding scheme to map latency-resilient routing under dual-link failures onto quantum circuits, demonstrating large reductions in qubit and circuit complexity while preserving the optimization objective and achieving a 100× higher success probability on trapped-ion hardware.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种面向结构的量子比特高效编码方法，将在双链路故障下的低时延鲁棒路径规划映射到量子电路中，并在保持原优化目标不变的前提下显著降低所需量子比特数与编译电路复杂度，且在困束离子量子计算机上获得了100倍的成功概率提升。

title: Judd-Ofelt analysis and coherent spectroscopy of europium-based molecular complexes for quantum information applications
abstract: Rare-earth-ion based molecular crystals are emerging as a promising platform for quantum information applications, combining long optical coherence times with the chemical tunability of coordination chemistry. Here we present a comprehensive optical characterisation of twelve Eu$^{3+}$-based molecular complexes, with a focus on the coherent $^{5}\text{D}_{0} \longrightarrow \ ^{7}\text{F}_{0}$ transition at $\sim$580 nm. Judd-Ofelt analyses are performed across all complexes, providing insights into ligand-field environments, local point-group symmetries, and the resulting branching ratios of the coherent transition. We find that lower point-group symmetry (C$_1$, C$_2$) yields higher branching ratios of the $^{5}\text{D}_{0} \longrightarrow \ ^{7}\text{F}_{0}$ transition, exceeding 1\% in several complexes. Optical inhomogeneous linewidths measured at 4.2 K reveal narrow linewidths for some complexes of below ten GHz, indicative of a highly ordered crystalline environment. Optical coherence measurements of one of the complexes, 5-Eu, yields an optical coherence time of $T_{\text{2}}^{\text{opt}} = 2.3~\mu\mathrm{s}$ at 4.2 K, comparable to the best-performing molecular systems reported to date. Systematic characterisation and quantitative comparison will be key to find structure-property relations guiding rational design of optimised complexes for quantum information applications.

summaries.en: The paper performs Judd–Ofelt optical analysis and coherent spectroscopy of twelve Eu3+-based molecular complexes, showing that lower ligand-field point-group symmetry can produce >1% branching ratios for the 5D0→7F0 transition and that some complexes exhibit inhomogeneous linewidths below 10 GHz and an optical coherence time of T2opt=2.
summaries.zh: 本文对十二种基于Eu3+的分子复合物开展Judd–Ofelt光学分析与相干谱学表征，结果表明较低的配体场点群对称性可使5D0→7F0跃迁的分支比超过1%，部分复合物在4.

title: QTN-RQNN: Quantum Tensor Network-Based Recurrent Quantum Neural Network
abstract: Resource constraints and imperfect quantum operations remain major challenges for quantum machine learning (QML) on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, particularly for fault-diagnosis tasks involving imbalanced and heterogeneous data. This work proposes QTN-RQNN, a Quantum Tensor Network-Based Recurrent Quantum Neural Network that integrates tensor-network-inspired nearest-neighbor interactions with recurrent quantum processing. The model sequentially encodes input features while propagating quantum memory across recurrent steps and incorporates QSMOTE for class balancing. QTN-RQNN is evaluated on four heterogeneous fault-diagnosis datasets SPID, CWRUBD, EFDD, and SFDD and compared with QNN, QTN-QNN, and RQNN baselines through classification, ablation, multi-seed, convergence, and quantum-resource analyses. Results show dataset-dependent predictive behavior, indicating that increased quantum architectural complexity does not universally improve classification. On SPID, QTN-RQNN improves the RQNN F1-score from 0.3077 to 0.4516 and ROC-AUC from 0.4485 to 0.6970, while the remaining datasets exhibit different performance-resource trade-offs and sensitivity to recurrent timesteps and circuit depth. Across all datasets, QTN-RQNN reduces the two-qubit-gate count from 32 to 24 per sample relative to RQNN, corresponding to a 25% reduction without increasing the four-qubit requirement; the same relative reduction is obtained for QTN-QNN over QNN. These findings establish QTN-RQNN as a resource-conscious recurrent quantum architecture and highlight the need to jointly consider predictive performance and circuit-resource requirements for near-term quantum fault diagnosis.

summaries.en: The paper introduces QTN-RQNN, a quantum tensor-network-inspired recurrent QNN that uses sequential feature encoding and QSMOTE for imbalanced fault diagnosis, achieving improved metrics on SPID while showing dataset-dependent performance–resource trade-offs and reducing two-qubit gate counts versus RQNN without increasing four-qubit needs.
summaries.zh: 本文提出QTN-RQNN，这是一种基于量子张量网络相邻相互作用的循环量子神经网络，用于通过序列化特征编码并结合QSMOTE解决不平衡故障诊断问题，在SPID上取得了指标提升，同时表现出数据集相关的性能—资源权衡，并在不增加四比特需求的情况下相较于RQNN显著减少了两比特门数量。

title: Dynamical Lie Algebras for Fixed-Gate Quantum Ansätze
abstract: Parameterized Quantum Circuits have emerged as a central framework for variational quantum algorithms in the NISQ regime, with major applications in quantum simulation, combinatorial optimization, and, more recently, quantum machine learning (QML). By developing a new approach for computing dynamical Lie algebras associated with quantum circuits combining parametrized gates and non-parametrized entangling gates, we aim to extend the applicability of recent algebraic results to architectures that are actually used in quantum machine learning.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a method to compute dynamical Lie algebras for quantum circuits that mix parametrized gates with fixed (non-parameterized) entangling gates, extending algebraic results to variational ansätze used in NISQ-era quantum machine learning.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种用于计算将参数化门与固定（非参数化）纠缠门相结合的量子电路的动力学李代数的方法，从而将相关代数结果推广到NISQ时代并用于量子机器学习的变分约化结构中。

title: Enhanced analogue quantum computation with a logically-encoded XX gadget
abstract: The introduction of two-body XX interactions has been shown to improve the performance of quantum annealing in solving certain combinatorial optimisation problems and would enable the simulation of a broader class of many-body Hamiltonians. Due to experimental constraints, such interactions are typically not natively available on analogue quantum devices. To overcome this limitation we introduce the truss gadget. This is an exact construction that generates two-body XX interactions using only one-body X and Z fields and two-body ZZ interactions which are readily accessible on, for instance, superconducting quantum annealers. We experimentally validate the construction by reproducing the dynamics of a target XX Hamiltonian on a trapped-ion quantum processor. We then apply the gadget to an illustrative set of instances of the weighted maximum-independent-set problem on a superconducting quantum annealer. We empirically determine an approximate thousand-fold improvement in the probability of finding a state close to the ground state for these instances, over implementation without an XX interaction.

summaries.en: The paper proposes the “truss gadget,” an exact circuit that realizes two-body XX interactions using only one-body X and Z fields plus accessible two-body ZZ couplings, experimentally verifies it on a trapped-ion processor by reproducing XX Hamiltonian dynamics, and demonstrates on a superconducting annealer that incorporating the gadget yields an empirically ~1000× higher probability of obtaining near-ground-state solutions for weighted maximum-independent-set instances.
summaries.zh: 本文提出“桁架（truss）gadget”，通过仅使用可获得的单体X/Z场和双体ZZ耦合来精确构造等效的双体XX相互作用，先在离子阱处理器上通过重现目标XX哈密顿量动力学对其进行实验验证，并在超导量子退火器上将其用于加权最大独立集问题实例，实验性地观察到获得接近基态解的概率相较不加入XX相互作用约提升1000倍。

title: GPU-Based Parallel BP Decoding for Quantum LDPC Memory
abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) decoding requires reliable corrections and low latency over long syndrome histories. We extend BP-SF, an oscillation-guided belief-propagation (BP) decoder with independent syndrome-flip trials, by introducing windowed and streaming operations. Our CUDA implementation combines disordered-memory retries, sliding windows, correlation-aware graphs, and layered scheduling. Circuit-level simulations test fixed-basis memory and complete logical Pauli-frame recovery. On the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code at physical error rate p = 0.002, parallel BP-SF reduces 99.9th-percentile call latency by a factor of 13.15 relative to an eight-chain Relay-BP GPU baseline on 100,000 matched samples for which every tested method's initial BP stage fails within 80 iterations. Windowed BP-SF maintains a flat logical error rate and nearly constant per-round compute time through 512 rounds, reaching a 17.1-fold speedup over monolithic decoding. In 512-round full-frame streaming decoding with 2.97-ms syndrome arrivals, layered BP-SF on a transformed joint graph with 20 retries reduces 99.9th-percentile correction-release age from 166.29 to 36.25 ms relative to the joint graph with flooding updates and 100 retries. These results connect parallel BP post-processing to lower decoding costs and earlier correction release in streaming quantum memory.

summaries.en: The paper presents a CUDA-based parallel extension of BP-SF belief-propagation decoding for quantum LDPC memory, using windowed/streaming operations and GPU scheduling to cut extreme-latency and correction-release age while maintaining low logical error rates in circuit-level simulations of LDPC codes.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种面向量子LDPC存储器的CUDA并行化BP-SF置信传播解码方法，通过引入分窗口/流式操作与GPU调度，在电路级仿真中降低极端延迟与更早释放纠错，同时保持较低逻辑错误率。

title: Optical atomic clocks on all-optical atom chips
abstract: The feasibility and potential performance of optical clocks based on all-optical atom chips using neutral strontium atoms have been investigated. The key benefits of all-optical atom chips are their ability to trap alkali-earth atoms, and how easily these atoms can be manipulated and examined. The planar configuration of the chip enables ring photonic resonators to be incorporated into its structure, making it a promising candidate for active optical atomic clocks. Using the 'magic wavelengths' of the trapping optical fields (813 nm and 390 nm for strontium atoms) minimises frequency shifts in the intercombination clock transition caused by variations in optical field intensity. However, this frequency shift can be compensated for using optical AC Stark shifts, which are generated by the trapping optical fields and have frequencies below the 'magic frequencies'. Furthermore, it has been demonstrated that atom chip clocks can operate using solely repulsive, blue-detuned evanescent light fields when the attraction of the trapped atoms towards the photonic waveguide is realised through van der Waals forces alone. According to estimates, this could result in the short-term fractional frequency stability of the strontium atom-chip optical clocks being limited to ~10^{-16} per second, with an accuracy of about 5 x 10^{-15} for fractional intensity stability in the trapping light fields of 0.001.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes the feasibility and projected performance of all-optical atom-chip optical clocks using neutral strontium atoms, leveraging ring photonic resonators and magic trapping wavelengths to minimize clock-transition shifts while showing that chip operation can rely only on repulsive blue-detuned evanescent fields and may achieve ~10^-16 s^-1 short-term stability with ~5×10^-15 accuracy under 0.
summaries.zh: 本文评估了基于中性锶原子的全光原子芯片光学钟的可行性与预期性能，芯片内集成环形光子谐振器并利用“魔术波长”降低时钟跃迁受限于俘获光强变化的频移，同时证明可仅用排斥的蓝失谐倏逝场工作且通过仅由范德华力实现原子向光波导靠近，估计在俘获光场强度分数稳定度为0.
